court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court No.5 at Bandra, Petition No.A-1109/2018
facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent were married in 2002. A son was born in 2004. The wife filed a petition for restitution of conjugal rights and other reliefs due to marital discord and allegations of husband's extra-marital affair. The trial court allowed an application to amend the petition.

legal_principles.principle: The concept of changing the nature of a suit is foreign to matrimonial matters.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, it was held that the principle laid down in M/s.Revajeetu Builders and Developers vs Narayanaswamy and Sons and ors, (2009) 10 SCC 84, which propound the law on amendment of pleadings in routine civil matters, was held to be inappropriate.
cited_cases: Uttara Praveen Thool Vs. Praveen s/o Bhanudas Thool, 2014 (2) Mh.L.J, 321
M/s.Revajeetu Builders and Developers vs Narayanaswamy and Sons and ors, (2009) 10 SCC 84

legal_principles.principle: The Family Court should test the bonafide of an application and shall not refuse a bonafide, legitimate, honest and necessary amendment.
legal_principles.held: He would submit that ultimately, the Court must test the bonafide of the application and shall not refuse bonafide, legitimate, honest and necessary amendment, but it shall not permit malafide, worthless and/or dishonest amendments

outcome.final_order: The impugned order is set aside.
